title: Football transfer rumours: Edinson Cavani to leave PSG for Chelsea?
trail: Gabriel Jesus to Real Madrid? | Sofiane Boufal to Watford? | Jeffrey Schlupp and Ciaran Clark to West Bromwich Albion?
body: Today is the birthday of that wonderful football innovator the late Jimmy Hill so it’s a shame that the first rumour the Mill has to report to you is that hackneyed old saw about Chelsea wanting Edinson Cavani. It has been hard to know during the last three years whether the Paris Saint-Germain striker really has been yearning for a move to the Premier League or has just been cultivating a vibe of existential torment to fit in with the hip set on the Rive Gauche, but tales of his desire to leave France for England have become suitably cliched. Mind you, the Mill rather thought there’d be some quiet on that front since Zlatan Ibrahimovic got out of the striker’s way at PSG but word is that Chelsea are determined to keep picking at the sore because Diego Costa is off to pick fights elsewhere despite his mooted move back to Atlético Madrid seemingly having broken down a couple of days ago. And if Cavani admits that he is happy in Paris, after all, then Chelsea will just keep trying to retread old ground and offer Everton around £50m to let Romelu Lukaku do likewise. Elsewhere, Manchester City may have been foiled in their attempt to sign the new Jesus. An ambitious move, to be fair, but they thought they’d sealed it. Alas, it now seems that Real Madrid have persuaded the 19-year-old Brazilian forward Gabriel Jesus to believe in them instead, leaving City to curse the Spanish club’s diabolical intervention. Upon considering the matter, and the performances of a certain Señor Navas, City are thought to be unsurprised that Jesus got into a position to do something thrilling only to dismay them with his final decision. José Mourinho might feel some empathy for his old mucker Pep. The Manchester United manager may let on that he’s only one Paul Pogba away from a complete team but there’s a suspicion that he knows his defence is still fragile: reports in Spain claim he has tried to lure Raphaël Varane to Old Trafford this summer but the French centre-back spurned his advances. West Bromwich Albion would have no trouble prising Ciaran Clark from Aston Villa if they just stumped up £5m, which is the value of the centre-back’s release clause, but the Baggies are yet to put in the offer, possibly because they’re busy beating Sunderland to the signature of the Lorient striker Benjamin Moukandjo. Tony Pulis is also trying to persuade Leicester to let go of Jeffrey Schlupp. Watford like the look of Lille’s goal-scoring midfielder Sofiane Boufal, while Crystal Palace are eyeing the former Lille striker Moussa Sow, who is currently pulling up (palm) trees with the United Arab Emirates side Al-Ahli.
